usage: Antiviral used to treat infections caused by herpes viruses (shingles, chickenpox).
dosage: Usually 1 tablet 3-5 times daily as directed. Complete the course. Consult a doctor.
warnings: Ensure adequate water intake to protect kidneys.
Finish full course to prevent recurrence.
storage: Store in a cool and dry place.

usage: Used for treatment and prevention of influenza (flu).
dosage: As directed by physician; usually twice daily for 5 days. Consult a professional.
warnings: Effective when started within 48 hours of symptoms.
Monitor for behavioral changes in children.

usage: Used for various fungal infections of skin, mouth, and internal organs.
dosage: Take after a full meal. Follow doctor's prescription strictly.
warnings: Inform doctor of any liver disease.
Avoid if you have heart failure history.

usage: Used for fungal infections including vaginal yeast infections.
dosage: Often a single dose as directed by physician. Consult a professional.
warnings: May interact with many other medications.
Caution in liver disease.

genericName: Diclofenac + Methyl Salicylate + Menthol + Linseed Oil
usage: Used for relief from muscle and joint pain, sprains, and strains.
dosage: Apply to the affected area 3-4 times a day. Do not use on broken skin.
warnings: External use only.
Wash hands after application.
Do not cover with tight bandages.

usage: Relieves pain and inflammation in muscles and joints.
dosage: One tablet twice daily after food. Consult a healthcare professional.
warnings: Avoid in patients with peptic ulcers.
Limit alcohol consumption.

usage: Antifungal cream used to treat skin infections like athlete's foot.
dosage: Apply thin layer to affected area twice daily. Follow doctor's guidance.
warnings: For external use only.
Complete full course even if skin clears early.

usage: Potent steroid used for skin allergies and inflammatory conditions.
dosage: Apply once daily as directed by doctor. Use sparingly on the face.
warnings: Do not use for a long duration.
Avoid covering treated area with airtight dressings.

usage: Used for relief of inflammatory and pruritic manifestations of corticosteroid-responsive dermatoses.
dosage: Apply once daily to the affected skin area as prescribed. Consult a professional.
warnings: Not for long-term use on large areas of skin.
Caution in children.
storage: Protect from freezing. Store at room temperature.

usage: Used for treatment of dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis of the scalp.
dosage: Apply to scalp, leave for 3-5 minutes before rinsing. Use twice weekly initially. Consult a professional.
warnings: Avoid contact with eyes.
Discontinue if severe irritation occurs.

usage: Antiseptic cream for minor cuts, grazes, and small burns.
dosage: Apply to the cleaned affected area 1-3 times daily. Seek professional advice.
warnings: For external use only.
Consult doctor for deep wounds or large burns.

genericName: Boric Acid + Zinc Oxide + Anhydrous Lanolin
usage: Antiseptic cream for chapped lips, dry skin, and minor cuts.
dosage: Clean area and apply generously, preferably at night. Consult a dermatologist for skin issues.
warnings: External use only.
Not for deep wounds.
storage: Store in a cool, dry place.

usage: Antiseptic cream for treatment of minor burns and skin injuries.
dosage: Apply on the affected area as needed. Follow doctor's guidance for severe burns.
warnings: Do not use on severe third-degree burns.
Seek medical help for infected burns.

usage: Ayurvedic multipurpose cream for cuts, burns, skin issues, and even internal use (as directed).
dosage: External: apply on affected area. Internal: 1 teaspoon for adults (consult ayurvedic practitioner).
warnings: Consult an ayurvedic doctor for internal consumption.
Keep away from children.

genericName: Wintergreen Oil + Menthol + Eucalyptus Oil + Turpentine Oil
usage: Topical spray for quick relief from muscle pain and backache.
dosage: Spray on the affected area from 5cm distance 3-4 times a day. Consult a professional.
warnings: Do not spray on open wounds.
Flammable; keep away from heat.

genericName: Pudina Ka Phool + Gandhapura Tel + Kapoor
usage: Herbal balm for relief from headache and cold.
dosage: Massage gently on the forehead or affected area. Consult a physician.
warnings: Wash hands after use.
Avoid contact with eyes.

usage: Used for relief from muscle, joint pain, and inflammation.
dosage: Apply 3-4 times daily on affected area. Seek professional advice.
warnings: For external use only.
Do not use on injured skin.

genericName: Sodium Alginate + Sodium Bicarbonate + Calcium Carbonate
usage: Forms a protective layer on stomach contents to prevent acid reflux and heartburn.
dosage: 10-20 ml or 2-4 tablets after meals and at bedtime. Consult a physician.
warnings: Low sodium diet patients should use with caution.
Maintain gap with other drugs.

usage: Antacid for quick relief from acidity and indigestion.
dosage: Dissolve one sachet/teaspoon in a glass of water. Consult a professional.
warnings: Do not take for more than 14 days.
High sodium content.

usage: Ayurvedic medicine for relief from stomach ache, gas, and indigestion.
dosage: 1 capsule 2-3 times daily for adults with water. Consult a physician.
warnings: Not recommended for children under 12.
Consult doctor if stomach pain is severe.
storage: Store in a cool and dry place.

usage: Daily maintenance dose of Vitamin D for healthy bones and immunity.
dosage: One tablet daily or as directed. Consult a professional.
warnings: Monitor blood calcium levels if on long-term treatment.
Inform doctor of kidney issues.

usage: Calcium supplement for growing children and to treat deficiency.
dosage: Typically 1-2 teaspoonfuls daily. Consult a pediatrician.
warnings: Shake well before use.
Maintain adequate water intake.

usage: General multivitamin tonic to improve immunity and support growth.
dosage: One teaspoonful daily for children or as directed. Consult a pediatrician.
warnings: Consult doctor before use in chronic conditions.
Do not exceed dose.

usage: Rich source of Omega-3, Vitamin A and D for heart and brain health.
dosage: Adults: 1 capsule thrice daily. Consult a professional.
warnings: Inform doctor if taking blood thinners.
Monitor Vitamin A levels.

usage: Ayurvedic medicine to support kidney health and help flush out kidney stones.
dosage: 2 tablets twice daily until stones pass. Consult a physician.
warnings: Maintain high water intake.
Consult doctor for large or obstructive stones.
